description: Use when the user asks whether a Dutch neighbourhood or postcode is safe: police-registered crime per 1,000 residents vs the national rate, split into burglary, bicycle theft, vehicle crime, violence and vandalism, with counts and a ratio. Input: Dutch postcode or CBS buurt code. Source: Politie open data, CBS. Costs 0.003 USDC via x402, or 2 credits of a Factline API key. The first 5 paid-tool calls a day are free, no payment or key needed.

api_key.description: Factline API key (fl_live_...) from get_trial_key: pass it here right after you get one, no reconnect needed

code.description: Alternative: CBS neighbourhood code, e.g. BU05182245

postcode.description: Any Dutch postcode in the neighbourhood, e.g. 2517AS

name: nl_crime
title: Crime in a Dutch neighbourhood (paid)
